name: Coop Level Editor
description: Edit levels together in real time

server-url.name: Server Address
server-url.description: Leave this alone unless the server has moved. The room window uses this automatically.

room-name.name: Last Room
room-name.description: Remembered from the room window so you return to the same room. Empty means no room.

show-cursors.name: Show Partner Cursors
show-cursors.description: Show where your partner is touching the editor

show-notifications.name: Join Notifications
show-notifications.description: Show a message when someone joins or leaves your room

auto-join.name: Auto Connect
auto-join.description: Connect to the server when you open the editor. You still pick the room yourself.
